messages:
zoe: Customer (acme-app) reporting a sudden wave of 429s on /v1/generate after midnight UTC. Also p95 latency up to 2.8s. Tenant T-ACME-12, model rwd/gpt-medium-8k. Anyone on this?
sam: Can you paste a short repro and earliest 429? tenant id and route noted, thx.
zoe: Repro: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
logs:
```
2026-03-10T00:12:01Z tenant=T-ACME-12 route=/v1/generate model=rwd/gpt-medium-8k status=429 reason=quota_exceeded:burst x-tenant-usage=950/1000
2026-03-10T00:12:02Z tenant=T-ACME-12 route=/v1/generate model=rwd/gpt-medium-8k status=429 reason=kv_cache_miss
2026-03-10T00:12:05Z tenant=T-ACME-12 route=/v1/generate model=rwd/gpt-medium-8k status=200 latency_ms=2300
```
We see bursts then fallthroughs.

maria: Ops: check limits.dashboard -> panel 'Throttles by route/tenant' and 'Per-model 429 rate'. Quick prom queries:
```
sum(rate(api_request_total{status="429",route="/v1/generate",tenant="T-ACME-12"}[5m])) by (model)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(api_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate",tenant="T-ACME-12"}[5m])) by (le))
```
Also overlay quota usage metric: `tenant_quota_consumed{tenant="T-ACME-12"}`

ops-bot: ALERT ThrottlingHigh fired for T-ACME-12 at 2026-03-10T00:12:03Z :red_circle:

sam: Two likely causes: (1) tenant hit reserved token quota causing burst fallback to shared pool which has stricter per-route limits, or (2) model change increased token/time causing unexpected throughput. Suggest:
- capture per-route token/sec and per-tenant quota counters
- run a controlled replay to reproduce
- if customer is urgent, bump tenant soft quota for 30m and monitor

devex: For reproducer, try a short load test that preserves token sizes:
```
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"long prompt..."}' &
done; wait
```
Also enable `response-caching: prefix` on their route if many repeated prompts.

alex: On infra side, I see per-route burst tokens depleted around 00:11:58Z, per-tenant rate stayed below absolute limit but their burst capacity exhausted. We should check our burst refill policy. I can patch refill to be slightly more forgiving for Dedicated customers.

maria: For attribution SQL over logs:
```
SELECT tenant, route, model, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status=429) AS throttles
FROM api_logs
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-10T00:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-10T01:00:00Z'
GROUP BY tenant, route, model
ORDER BY throttles DESC;
```
This will tell us whether it's per-model or per-route rooted.

zoe: Steps I'll take: 1) open support ticket with request for 30 min soft quota bump, 2) run controlled repro with devex script, 3) attach dashboard links and SQL outputs to ticket. If mitigation needed I'll request short canary route override.

sam: If this is customer-impacting >1h, flag for postmortem. Also add an alert to signal 'BurstTokenDepletion' (prom: `rate(burst_tokens_left{tenant="T-ACME-12"}[1m]) < 0.01`)

zoe: ack, creating ticket now. tagging @maria and @alex to follow infra/observability actions. :white_check_mark:

maria: follow-up: I pushed a custom dashboard panel that joins `tenant_quota_consumed` + `api_request_total` so you can see usage vs throttles per-model. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/acl/T-ACME-12

zoe: customer agreed to temp quota bump; monitoring. Will update thread with root cause once we have logs aggregation. Thanks all.
